personality_one_liner: A deep, mystical, and premium spiritual discipline experience driven by glowing golden accents, 60fps cinematic motion, and an ink-dark obsidian void.

spacing.rule: Generous and cinematic. Use large paddings to make the glowing gold elements and sacred texts stand out. No crowded views.

do's: Use dark frosted glass (`rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.7)` + blur) for the floating pill bottom tab bar.
Use glass overlays for the home header card and community wall expansion cards.
Apply a subtle gold tint `rgba(245, 197, 66, 0.05)` to elevated modal glass surfaces.
dont's: Don't blur dense input forms in the Journey Setup wizard.
Don't use glass without a translucent base color to ensure text contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Premium Motion requirement: You MUST use react-native-reanimated for all major interactions. 60fps butter-smooth motion is a core requirement of this overhaul.
Implement the 'Hold-to-confirm' interaction using useSharedValue and gesture handlers. When pressed, fill an SVG ring or progress bar over ~1200ms. Fire a heavy haptic on success.

The 'Sacred Commitment Card' containing Burning Desire, Affirmation, and Sacrifice must dominate the screen. Use gold typography (onBrandPrimary or brandPrimary), a subtle gold border (borderStrong), and maybe a soft drop shadow mapped to the gold token to create a 'glowing' effect.
One Unified Font: Use 'Outfit' at weight 400 and 500 across the ENTIRE app. Do not mix any other font. Keep it clean and readable.

Any image used as a background MUST have a vertical expo-linear-gradient scrim layered over it, transitioning from transparent to #05050C at the bottom (>=70% opacity at stop 100%) to guarantee text readability.
Floating Pill Tab Bar: Position it absolutely at the bottom, above the safe area inset. Use a glassmorphism background (`expo-blur` over `rgba(15, 15, 26, 0.7)`). Keep it slim and premium.
Use Phosphor icons. Keep them consistently styled (e.g., entirely 'regular' or 'fill' variant) matching the premium aesthetics.
